title: working-capital balance read-back after the seeded disbursement
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json (GET /working-capital-loans/1, tenant gerege), the read-back that serialises the seeded loan's m_wc_loan_balance row. The detail seam grades the row id, its loan-status code, and nine balance money cells. STORED cells: balance.principal=1000.51 -> "100051", balance.principalPaid=0.0 -> "0", balance.totalDisbursement=0.0 -> "0" (Fineract does NOT move this column on the disbursement write path), balance.totalDiscountFee=0.0 -> "0". DERIVED cells (the port's balance getters, never stored): balance.principalOutstanding=1000.51 -> "100051", balance.totalExpectedRepayment=1000.51 -> "100051", balance.totalRepayment=0.0 -> "0", balance.totalOutstanding=1000.51 -> "100051", balance.unrealizedIncomeFromDiscountFee=0.0 -> "0". Structural: expect.detail.id="1" is the balance block's "id", expect.detail.status="loanStatusType.active" is the response "status":{"code":...} field. All money cells are transcribed as integer minor units; no cell is computed here.

provenance.note: Every expect field is transcribed from the committed capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json; capture_case_id names the seeded loan whose balance block is read back.
